preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have admin privileges via setAdminAddress)
Contract address(this) must have positive token balance (from _bounsFee accumulation)

exploit_hint: As owner, call sumTheBounsPool() with appropriate date strings (yesToday, twoYesToday) to transfer half of contract's token balance to dayPoolBouns[yesToday]. Then manipulate dayPoolBounsPiece via sumBounsPiece() to set a high piece value. Finally, call receiveBounsToken() (if bounsTime is reached) or wait for users to claim rewards, but the owner can front-run or manipulate the pool distribution. The key is that dayPoolBouns accumulates unclaimed rewards that can be manipulated by owner.
